english.title: Prohibited purchase of a specimen - Annex B list
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), purchased

(A)_[a specimen]_
(B)_[specimens]_

of a species, namely **(..SPECIFY..), which had been imported or acquired unlawfully and is listed in Annex B to Council Regulation (EC ) No 338/97 and in contravention of Article 8 of Council Regulation (EC ) No 338/97.
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 8(2) and (8) of the Control of Trade in Endangered Species (Enforcement) Regulations 1997.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
purchase a specimen
listed in Annex A to Council Regulation (EC ) No 338/97
which had been unlawfully imported/acquired

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
This CJS Code and Offence Wording document is OBSOLETE - amalgamated into CJS Code ES97012 and H14946.

(i) See Regulation 8(3) and Article 8 of Council Regulation (EC ) No 338/97 for conditions required for legal purchase, sale etc of specimens.
(ii) See Regulation 8(4) for defence of lack of knowledge of protected status of specimen of a species listed in Annex B of Council Regulation (EC ) No 338/97.
(iii) See also associated offence wordings H2871, H2872, H2873, H2874, H2875 and H2876.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Gwaharddedig - Prynu sbesimen - Rhestr Atodiad B
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording: Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) bu i chi brynu (A)_[sbesimen]_ (B)_[sbesimenau]_ rhywogaeth, sef **(..SPECIFY..), a fewnforiwyd neu a gafwyd yn anghyfreithlon ac a restrir yn Atodiad B i Reoliad y Cyngor (EC ) Rhif 338/97 ac yn groes i Erthygl 8 o Reoliad y Cyngor (EC ) Rhif 338/97.
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i reoliad 8(2) ac (8) o Reoliadau Rheoli Masnach mewn Rhywogaethau Mewn Perygl (Gorfodi) 1997.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Five years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
